title: ficus imbricata var. subcordata
intro: Ficus imbricata var. subcordata, commonly known as the Banyan Fig or Ficus Subcordata, is a plant species belonging to the Ficus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ficus imbricata var. subcordata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
